::: {.ftw-callout .ftw-callout-scam}
### <i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i> Worried something's a scam?

A pop-up says your computer is infected.
Someone claiming to be your bank, Medicare, or a grandkid needs money right now.
**Stop, and call me before you click, pay, or call back.**
A quick "is this a scam?" call or text is always free, and there's no such thing as a silly question.

[More on scam help →](scams.qmd)
:::

::: {.ftw-callout .ftw-callout-info}
### <i class="bi bi-windows" aria-hidden="true"></i> Still on Windows 10?

You don't have to throw it out yet.
Microsoft has [extended security updates for Windows 10](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/extended-security-updates) for home users who enroll, and some older computers can move to Windows 11.
I can help you sort out the best option, or help pass the computer on to someone who can use it.
:::

## How it works

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-bicycle" aria-hidden="true"></i> In person
I'll come to your home or business in Fruita, or we can meet at a coffee shop or the library.
(If I can get there on my bike, even better.)
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-headset" aria-hidden="true"></i> Phone or screen share
Plenty of problems can be fixed without either of us leaving the house.
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-heart" aria-hidden="true"></i> Pay what's fair
I have a typical hourly rate, but if money's tight, we'll work something out, trades included.
Cash, check, card, or Venmo.
:::
